The '''Sith mineralogical corps''' was an organization within the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] that focused on finding and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] and other rare stones. [[Devore Korsin]] was a member of the corps.
